highlights:
Revolutionizing Transportation Management: BeyondTrucks Secures $10.35 Million in Series A Funding | Signalbase
...
Funding news Published October 24, 2024
...
BeyondTrucks, a leading provider of Smart Transportation Management Software, has successfully raised $10,350,000 in its latest funding round, signifying a crucial step toward revolutionizing the logistics and transportation industry. Specializing in replacing outdated on-premise software, BeyondTrucks empowers shippers and carriers to streamline operations by automating manual processes that previously slowed productivity. The infusion of capital will be utilized to enhance the functionality of their cloud-based platform, ensuring it remains user-friendly while adeptly handling the complexities that modern businesses face within the transportation sector. BeyondTrucks is committed to delivering a configurable solution that not only simplifies transportation management but also drives efficiency and visibility throughout the supply chain. This funding will allow the company to accelerate its development initiatives, expand its engineering team, and innovate new features tailored to meet the evolving demands of their clients. With this significant backing, BeyondTrucks is poised to set new industry standards, further establishing itself as a go-to resource for organizations seeking to modernize their logistics operations. As the demand for agile and flexible transportation solutions continues to grow, BeyondTrucks is ready to lead the way, helping fleets transition to a smarter, more efficient future. The support of our investors underscores a shared vision for a seamless integration of technology in transportation management, paving the way for enhanced collaboration between shippers and carriers across the globe.

# BeyondTrucks has filed a notice of an exempt offering of securities to raise $11,399,982.00 in New Equity Investment.

According to filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, BeyondTrucks is raising up to $11,399,982.00 in new funding. Sources indicate that as part of senior management Chief Executive Officer, Hans Galland played a key role in securing the recent investment and it will aid in aggressively expanding the company, as well as broaden and accelerate product development.

SAN FRANCISCO and SAN DIEGO, Oct. 27, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- BeyondTrucks, provider of a transportation management system (TMS) designed to replace current legacy software and manual processes by providing enterprise fleets with a multi-tenant platform built for AI, today announced at ATA's 2025 Management Conference & Exhibition a powerful Optimization Solution that enables a new, real-time, AI-powered tactical approach to optimization natively in its platform.

 

 The BeyondTrucks powerful Optimization Solution enables a new, real-time, AI-powered tactical approach to optimization natively in its platform. Unlike traditional systems that assume a static operating environment, the BeyondTrucks Optimization Solution is designed for the real-world complexities of the highly dynamic context in which fleets operate. 

Suboptimal dispatch planning decisions cost American truck fleets between $150 and $200 billion every year" said Hans Galland, CEO of BeyondTrucks. "Dispatchers either rely on tribal knowledge or struggle with optimization tools that don't fit their workflow. Plans become obsolete the moment they're created. And making adjustments requires either waiting days for engineering support or manually overriding the system—undermining the very efficiency the technology promised to deliver.
...
About BeyondTrucks - San Francisco-based BeyondTrucks offers specialty and private enterprise fleets a modern, AI-native Transportation Management System to become more efficient, make better decisions, and reinforce their customer service advantage. Built in the multi-tenant cloud, the SOC-2 compliant platform replaces legacy systems and manual processes with unified workflows that automate operations and optimize decisions across the fleet. With more than 100 built-in integrations and a highly configurable architecture, the BeyondTrucks platform transforms specialized fleets of all types to remain competitive in the age of AI. For more information, visit www.beyondtrucks.com
